intent: Simple semantic table for invoices, lists, and text rows. Search and filters belong on DataTable. One piece.
useWhen: Listing invoices, products, or other short text rows
Inside Section on dashboard or list-detail patterns
doNotUseWhen: Search, filters, selection, or column settings — use DataTable

columns.note: numeric or align end right-aligns the column. emphasis or the first column is medium + text-primary.

rows.note: Values render in native td. ReactNode allowed so Actions can put kit DropdownMenu in a cell.

caption.note: Renders below the grid (caption-side bottom). Not a heading above the table.

size.note: md is compact: th 2.5rem, td padding space-2. sm a hair tighter, lg a hair roomier. Do not recreate DataTable 3–4rem rows.

emptyLabel.note: Shown in one td with colSpan when rows is empty.

footer.note: Renders tfoot one row: label in a td colSpan={columns.length-1}, value in last td end-aligned.

requirements: Column headers in thead with th scope=col
Optional caption describes the table and sits below
Empty state is one td with colSpan=columns.length and emptyLabel
Optional footer is tfoot with label spanning leading columns and value end-aligned

doNot: Do not invent TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, or TableCaption cousins
Do not compose HeaderCell or Cell — those stay on DataTable
snippet: <Table caption="A list of your recent invoices." columns={[{ key: 'invoice', header: 'Invoice', emphasis: true }, { key: 'status', header: 'Status' }, { key: 'method', header: 'Method' }, { key: 'amount', header: 'Amount', numeric: true, align: 'end' }]} rows={[{ invoice: 'INV001', status: 'Paid', method: 'Credit Card', amount: '$250.00' }]} footer={{ label: 'Total', value: '$2,500.00' }} emptyLabel="No results." />
